==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
My girlfriend and I have a fairy garden. Inside the fairy garden are a variety of different toys. One of them seems to be alive.

The living toy resembles a humanoid cat. It has white fur and dresses like a ballerina. It looks harmless but it has a mean personality and super strength.

I discover that a sorcerer is responsible for bringing the toy to life. I confront the sorcerer. Before he has a chance to respond, my alarm goes off and I wake up.
